open_items: Future validator and public command adapters must preserve this existing diagnostic contract; current model and read-only project integrations do not establish all command consumers.

Full command-level lint dispatch and the complete supported runtime/target filesystem matrix require their own actual evidence; bound library and observed project coverage remain limited to their collected tests.
Human presentation/documentation is not an automated oracle (TD-001).

oracle.requirement_contract: SpecRoad MUSS JSON-Parsefehler mit Datei, Zeile und Spalte ausgeben.
oracle.scope: Shared diagnostic values, stable semantic ordering and explicit threshold assessment over supplied, source-bound observations. These tests do not authenticate diagnostic producers, execute optional lint automatically or establish full CLI conformance.

preconditions: Explicit diagnostic data and already loaded, source-bound model reports.
steps: Construct and validate findings; preserve all observed machine locations and identities.
Apply an explicit threshold without rerunning rules and inspect structured counts and failure class.
